scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Zhou panics over the double-booked room while Chen unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Qing, Chen, and Mei inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Qing, Mei, and Zhou finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Hao arrives soaked from the rain, and Qing and Mei warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Hao admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Zhou celebrates the solved double-booking until Qing spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Qing returns Hao's leather notebook and hears the bathroom hot-water pipe clank and turn cool.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Chen delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
